name: 90304 · Inglewood, CA
findings: ZIP 90304 (Inglewood) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90304 (Inglewood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
